account.title: Set up Pornarr

library.title: Choose the library path
library.body: Pornarr stores imported media in this folder.
library.crossFilesystem: This library is on a different filesystem from downloads. Imports will copy instead of hardlinking.

filters.title: Review content filters
filters.body: Every filter starts off. You can configure rules after setup without changing what is already imported.

term.title: Words and phrases
term.body: Blocks media whose title or description matches a rule you add later.

tag.title: Tags
tag.body: Blocks media carrying a tag you choose later.

performer.title: Performers
performer.body: Blocks media featuring a performer you choose later.

minimumConfidence.title: Metadata confidence
minimumConfidence.body: Holds media whose metadata match falls below a threshold you choose later.

unknownPerformerAge.title: Unknown performer age
unknownPerformerAge.body: Holds media when a matched performer’s age is not known.

unknownFileType.title: Unknown file type
unknownFileType.body: Holds media when the imported file type is not recognised.

metadata.title: Metadata providers
metadata.body: External metadata providers are optional. Pornarr can start without one.
metadata.skipped: No metadata provider will be configured during this setup.

summary.body: Check these choices before creating the instance.

local.title: In your library
local.notSearched: Enter a title to search your local library.
local.empty: No matching library items. Indexer results may still find a release.

screen.notBuilt: This screen is not built yet.
screen.notFoundBody: There is nothing at this address. Pick a destination from the navigation.
screen.forbiddenBody: Your account is not allowed to open this. An administrator can change that.

connection.offlineBody: This device has no network connection. The screen updates itself when it comes back.
connection.reconnectingBody: The live connection to the server dropped. It is being re-established; nothing needs doing.

quarantine.title: Quarantine review
quarantine.intro: Review the evidence before a withheld file enters the library. Corrections are retained for later matches of the same source title.
quarantine.emptyBody: Files that need a decision appear here with their matching evidence.
quarantine.reasonHint: Choose a reason to review its affected files together.
quarantine.selectReasonWithCount: Select all {{count}} files for bulk approval
quarantine.previewUnavailable: No preview frames were supplied with this import.
quarantine.correctionHint: Only changed values are sent and become a correction for future matching source titles.
quarantine.bulkPreviewHint: These {{count}} files will be approved without metadata changes.

quality.title: Quality profiles
quality.intro: Set the qualities and release properties this instance accepts. Previewing uses the unsaved editor values, so every score and rule is explained before it is stored.
quality.profileHint: Profiles can be selected by monitors and requests.
quality.profileEditorHint: Order qualities by preference. Drag rows or use the buttons so the same order works with a keyboard.
quality.orderHint: The first row is the least preferred; later qualities are higher quality.
quality.cutoffHint: After {{quality}} has been reached, an existing file is not automatically replaced by a higher-scoring release.
quality.customFormatsHint: Give human-readable release properties a score. Conditions are evaluated together for required rules; optional rules match when any one applies.
quality.noFormatsBody: Add a format to reward or penalize a release property.
quality.conditionsHint: Choose familiar release properties, an operation and a value. For example: Codec equals hevc.
quality.previewHint: Paste a release name to see the detected quality, matching custom formats, score and decision without consulting documentation.
quality.noMatchedFormats: No custom formats matched this release.

reason.not_in_profile: The detected quality is not allowed by this profile.
reason.below_minimum_score: The total score is below this profile's required minimum.
reason.no_existing_file: No existing file is available, so this release can be grabbed.
reason.not_an_upgrade: The existing file has an equal or better score.
reason.cutoff_met: The existing file has already reached this profile's cutoff quality.
reason.upgrade_available: The release scores higher than the existing file and the cutoff has not been reached.
reason.quality_not_detected: No allowed quality could be detected from this release name.

library.title: Library
library.empty: Your library is empty. Configure a root folder and scan it to add media.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That username and password do not match.
errors.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your account is not allowed to do that.
errors.CSRF_FAILED: This request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
errors.LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.OIDC_DISCOVERY_FAILED: That identity provider could not be reached or answered with something unusable.
errors.WEB_ASSETS_MISSING: The interface files are missing from this installation.
errors.CONFIGURATION_INVALID: This instance is misconfigured. Check the server log.
errors.DECRYPTION_FAILED: A stored credential could not be read. The application secret does not match the one it was saved with.
errors.QUALITY_CONFIGURATION_INVALID: This quality profile or custom format is not valid. Check the selected qualities, cutoff and names.
errors.QUALITY_PROFILE_IN_USE: This quality profile is still required by the application and cannot be deleted.
errors.SETUP_REQUIRED: Finish setting up this instance before using the application.
errors.SETUP_ALREADY_COMPLETED: This instance has already been configured.
errors.SETUP_PATH_INVALID: That library path is unavailable, not a folder, or cannot be written to.
errors.BAD_REQUEST: That request was not something the server could use.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That does not exist, or no longer does.
errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: That action is not available on this address.
errors.CONFLICT: That clashes with something that already exists.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: That is too large to send.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of what was entered is not valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server ran into a problem. Check the server log.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The server is not ready yet. Try again shortly.
errors.NETWORK_UNREACHABLE: The server could not be reached. Check that it is running.
errors.brokenTitle: This screen could not be displayed.
errors.brokenStep: Try it again. If it keeps happening, reload the page and report the address you were on.

errorSteps.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Check the username and password, then sign in again.
errorSteps.NOT_AUTHENTICATED: Sign in again to carry on where you left off.
errorSteps.FORBIDDEN: Ask an administrator for access, or go back to the library.
errorSteps.CSRF_FAILED: Reload the page, then repeat the action.
errorSteps.LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED: Wait a minute, then try again.
errorSteps.OIDC_DISCOVERY_FAILED: Check the issuer address in settings, then try again.
errorSteps.WEB_ASSETS_MISSING: Rebuild or reinstall the application image.
errorSteps.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Pick another destination from the navigation.
errorSteps.CONFIGURATION_INVALID: Correct the settings named in the server log, then restart the server.
errorSteps.DECRYPTION_FAILED: Restore the original application secret, or enter the credential again.
errorSteps.QUALITY_CONFIGURATION_INVALID: Check the selected qualities, cutoff and names, then save again.
errorSteps.QUALITY_PROFILE_IN_USE: Choose another default profile or move the monitors to another profile first.
errorSteps.SETUP_REQUIRED: Finish the setup steps before using the application.
errorSteps.SETUP_ALREADY_COMPLETED: Sign in with the administrator account that already exists.
errorSteps.SETUP_PATH_INVALID: Choose an existing folder that Pornarr can read and write.
errorSteps.BAD_REQUEST: Change what was sent and try once more.
errorSteps.NOT_FOUND: Pick a destination from the navigation.
errorSteps.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: Go back and choose a different action.
errorSteps.CONFLICT: Open what already exists, or choose a different name.
errorSteps.VALIDATION_FAILED: Correct the highlighted fields, then submit again.
errorSteps.RATE_LIMITED: Wait a moment, then try again.
errorSteps.INTERNAL_ERROR: Try again. If it keeps happening, check the server log.
errorSteps.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Wait for the server to finish starting, then try again.
errorSteps.NETWORK_UNREACHABLE: Check that the server is running and reachable, then try again.
errorSteps.unknown: Try again, and quote this code if it keeps happening.
errorSteps.generic: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.
